프롬프트문장.구성: Composition: one complete object, centered and fully visible with no cropping, shown at an angle that gives convincing volume and depth, clean crisp outer edge for background removal, no background scene, no props.
프롬프트문장.품질: Accurate proportions and believable construction, interior linework that describes the object's real parts, controlled tonal shading that gives the form volume, material-specific surface detail. Visually rich but not busy.
프롬프트문장.공통금지: text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermarks, signatures, recognizable brands, resemblance to real people, extra objects, cropped parts, duplicated parts, flat clip-art look, generic icon shapes, uniform thick outlines, oversimplified geometry, plastic 3D rendering, cast shadow, glow, leftover background pixels, semi-transparent fringing
